law_name: Law No. L/2019/0028/AN of 7 June 2019 on Literary and Artistic Property (replaced Law 043/APN/CP/80 of 1980); implementing decree of 20 June 2022
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (Law L/2019/0028/AN of 7 June 2019, art. 39 as quoted on Commons talk page; quoted text reads 'seventy (80)' so 80 is possible; the repealed 1980 law gave life + 80, photographs/applied art life + 40) (unconfirmed)
digital_protection: New offences assimilated to counterfeiting incl. Beijing Treaty provisions (Art. 117) (unconfirmed)
fair_use_exceptions: Reproduction of works permanently in public places allowed unless main subject and commercial (Art. 27); private copying regime exists (details not seen); artist resale right 5% of pre-tax price managed by BGDA (2022 decree) (unconfirmed)
notes: WPPT accession 25 Feb 2002, in force 25 May 2002 (WIPO notification WPPT 33); WCT in force 25 May 2002 per WIPO 2002 status list; TRIPS from WTO member list; Berne not verified; OAPI link not verified
